name: stage_1_stand
description: Stand tabula-rasa.  Cruse hip2 ON (gain=1.0) as the standing scaffold; knee+hip1 Cruse off; all walking-reward channels zeroed; scripted gait OFF.  This is the D20 standing recipe.  Advances after 60 sim-sec sustained upright (best_cumulative_alive_ticks >= 3000) — watch it learn to stand, then stage 2 turns on the gait.

name: stage_2_scripted_walk
description: E0 open-loop scripted gait injected ON TOP of the standing body.  Walk pattern (lateral-sequence leg offsets [0, pi, pi/2, 3pi/2]); hip1_phase=pi (the propulsion phase that walked 6x best); amp hip1/hip2=0.4, knee=0.3; period 60 ticks.  Cruse hip2 stays on for posture.  Tweak SG amps/phase/period live to explore the drivable envelope.  This is the gait to observe — expect translation with some wander.
